verifications.note: Al Wasat, 2024-01-14, headline 'بدء تنفيذ خط الغاز 24 المغذي محطة كهرباء الخليج البخارية في سرت' (start of implementation of the 24-inch gas line feeding the Gulf steam power station in Sirte); body confirms Sirt Gulf for Gas Projects Co. began cutting paths/laying the line that week — directly supports 'construction' by inference (status token not literal, per confidence-tiers rule)

Ecofin Agency, 2026-07-15, reports NOC/Sirte Oil Production & Manufacturing Co. completed initial connection tests and expects gas deliveries 'within days' — commissioning/pre-operational phase, consistent with the line still being completed (construction) as of that date; verify_url passed 200 with requests UA even though interactive WebFetch hit a 403 bot-wall

resolutions.researcher_notes: Original current_ref (alwasat.ly/news/libya/426177) is NOT actually dead — it 200s and is a live, on-topic 2024 article; the DEAD_LINK classification in the brief appears to be a false negative (likely from an automated check that required the English pipeline name as an exact/fuzzy match against an Arabic-only page, which will never pass). Re-verified it directly and paired it with an independent 2026 English-language source (Ecofin Agency, citing NOC) describing the same line's final connection/testing phase. Both describe an active, multi-year build (implementation restarted 2024, still in commissioning tests as of mid-2026), which supports 'construction' as the recorded status. Additional same-topic Libyan outlets (eanlibya.com, libyaakhbar.com x2, ar.libyaobserver.ly) were checked but are republications of the same July-2026 NOC/GECOL statement, so not counted as a second independent source.

verifications.note: Sirt Gulf for Gas Projects (SGGP) own project-portfolio page: title 'Supply and installation of 5km gas pipeline 24" to Al-Khalij power plant (Sirte)'; Project Details list Client: General Electricity Company of Libya (GECOL), Date: February 11, 2016 — matches ProposalYear 2016 directly

resolutions.researcher_notes: Only verifiable source found dating this specific project to 2016 is SGGP's own project listing (the operating/contractor company named in the pipeline record). Searched English and Arabic press (Libya Herald, Libya Monitor [paywalled, headline-only 2017-10-08 'Electricity authority, Sirt Gulf discuss gas supply' — body inaccessible even via Wayback, so not usable], Al Masry Al Youm on SGGP's 2007 founding, Arabic Wikipedia on SGGP) for a second independent confirmation of the 2016 date specifically; none gave a citable, verifiable 2016 date for this pipeline. Staged as medium/single-source per the confidence-tier rules rather than left unresolved, since the source is primary (the implementing contractor) and directly states the date and client.
